summary: People joining mid game can't observe without killing themselves

comments.content:
Not much to it really, it would be nice to be able to just watch the round
if I come in part way through without having to creatively off myself. With
the amount of time it takes to actually die you're typically sat there with
a black screen for 5 minutes plus. If observe worked from the ready room
and just made you a spectator that would be great.
Type suicide, then type succumb. Done.
